threads.body: Removing `schema_url` makes this catalog entry disagree with Servlet 5 HTTP server telemetry: its shared `DefaultHttpServerInstrumenterBuilder` still sets `HttpSchemaUrls.SCHEMA_URL` (`https://opentelemetry.io/schemas/1.41.0`). The scope parser prefers a schema-bearing scope over a schema-less scope with the same name. Check that metadata collection includes the Servlet HTTP server scope, then regenerate the catalog rather than editing this generated entry manually.
threads.hunk:
@@ -16984,7 +16984,6 @@ libraries:
   source_path: instrumentation/servlet/servlet-5.0
   scope:
     name: io.opentelemetry.servlet-5.0

replies.body: Servlet 5's own HTTP server instrumenter still uses `1.41.0`. The `1.37.0` URL removed here came from the internal `sendError` and `sendRedirect` spans, which intentionally stopped declaring a schema in #21466. The nightly Servlet 5 tests collect Jetty 12's HTTP server telemetry, so this generated update correctly drops the old URL. Collecting the Servlet-owned HTTP scope with a standalone Servlet 5 test is a separate follow-up; this PR should not hand-edit the catalog. 🤖 AI-authored reply via Agency Finish PR.
